info.title: Lingara API
info.description: Generate vocabulary lists and lesson plans, and hold tutor conversations, in the languages Lingara teaches. Each call is paid for by the client that makes it: an `allowance` client spends its owner's allowance, and a `metered` client is billed for its usage.

tags.name: vocabulary
tags.description: Generate vocabulary lists at a learner's level.

tags.name: lesson-plans
tags.description: Create lesson plans, read them, and reconnect to one that is still generating.

tags.name: tutor
tags.description: Hold a conversation with the language tutor, one turn at a time.

tags.name: account
tags.description: See how much of your allowance is left.

post.description: Streams a list of words at the requested level. The stream sends `started` with the list's details, one `item` event per word, then `done`. Until the list is ready it sends keepalive comments only.

200.description: The list, one word per event

post.description: Starts generating a lesson plan and streams its progress. `started` names the plan as soon as it exists, so a dropped connection can reconnect with `GET /v1/lesson-plans/{id}/stream`. The stream ends with `result` or `error`. A plan served from the library arrives as a lone `result`.

example.context: Ordering food at a night market

200.description: The plan's progress, then the plan

get.description: Returns a lesson plan you own. A plan that is still generating has no `content` yet.

content.introduction: Order food and ask prices at a night market.

questions.prompt: Which word asks for a price?
questions.explanation: 多少钱 means how much money.

get.description: Rejoins the progress stream of a plan that is still generating. A finished plan answers one `result`. A plan still generating with no live stream to join answers one `pending`; poll `GET /v1/lesson-plans/{id}` until it is complete.

200.description: The plan's remaining progress, then the plan

post.description: Sends one message to the tutor and streams the reply as `delta` events, ending with `done`. Nothing is stored: send the recent conversation in `history`, up to 20 entries. `character` and `situation` set the scene. Requires a paid plan.

history.content: 欢迎！今天的荔枝很新鲜。

example.character: a fruit seller in a night market

200.description: The tutor's reply, piece by piece

get.description: Lists each allowance that applies to your account, with how much is used and when it resets.
Returns this API description as JSON, for the API version the request is answered under: the one named in `Lingara-Version`, or else the current version. No token is needed.

Lists every API version in the order it was minted, with its `state`, when it was minted and, once deprecated, its sunset date. `current` is the newest supported or LTS version, and `development` is the one still growing; each is `null` until such a version exists. No token is needed. Responses may be cached for an hour.

Returns one API version with its full `history`, its `summary` (in English) and its `spec`. The document at `spec.url` is this version's only when requested with the `Lingara-Version` header set to its id. `spec.sha256` is the hash of its frozen document, and is `null` while the version is still in development. An unknown id answers `404`. No token is needed. Responses may be cached for an hour.

oauth2.description: An OAuth 2.0 access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Create a client in your Lingara account, exchange its id and secret at the token URL for a token that lasts one hour, and exchange again when it expires. Each operation needs one scope.

scopes.lesson_plans:read: Read your lesson plans and reconnect to their progress.
scopes.tutor:converse: Hold tutor conversations. Requires a paid plan.
scopes.usage:read: See your remaining allowance, or a `metered` client's usage this month.

LingaraVersion.name: Lingara-Version
LingaraVersion.description: The API version to answer this request under. Without it, an access token gets the version its client is pinned to, and a request with no token gets the current version. The version still in development is reached only by naming it here. An unknown version answers `400` with code `api_version_unknown`. `GET /v1/versions` lists the versions.
The API version this response was answered under. Absent until the first version is frozen.

Deprecation.description: When this response's API version was deprecated, as `@` followed by Unix seconds. Present only on a deprecated version.

Sunset.description: The date from which this response's API version may be discontinued. Present only on a deprecated version.

Link.description: A link, with relation `deprecation`, to this API version's details. Present only on a deprecated version.

Error.description: The request was refused. `code` says why, and `error` says it in words.

PaymentRequired.description: A metered client's call was refused before it spent anything. `spend_cap_reached`: the client or its account has reached its monthly spending limit; raise the limit on the Integrations page. `metered_billing_inactive`: usage billing is not active for this account; set it up, or update the payment method, on the Integrations page.

VersionDiscontinued.description: The API version this request is answered under has been discontinued. Send a supported version in `Lingara-Version`, or re-pin the client.

Unavailable.description: The service is temporarily unavailable; retry after the number of seconds in `Retry-After`. During maintenance the body is plain text rather than the error envelope.

ledger.description: This client's calls and units since midnight UTC on the first of the month. Present only for a metered client, whose calls spend no allowance. It can trail your latest call by up to five seconds.

code.description: Why the request was refused, as a stable code to branch on: for example `insufficient_scope` (`403`), `rate_limited` (`429`) and, for a metered client, `spend_cap_reached` (`402`) and `metered_billing_inactive` (`402`).
